heroDesc: SehatSetu brings doctors, patients, health records, intelligent assistance, and essential healthcare services together in one accessible digital platform.
heroDescSecondary: Built to make quality healthcare easier to reach across both rural and urban India.
storyP1: SehatSetu was created around a simple problem: access to timely healthcare should not depend on distance.
storyP2: For many people, especially those living far from major healthcare centres, seeing the right doctor can involve long travel, waiting times, and difficulty managing medical information.
storyP3: SehatSetu aims to reduce those barriers by connecting patients with verified healthcare professionals and essential digital health services through one platform.
missionText: Make trusted healthcare services easier to access, understand, and manage through technology.
visionText: Build a connected healthcare experience where distance, language, and digital complexity do not prevent people from receiving timely care.

featureVerifiedDoctors.title: सत्यापित देखभाल, कहीं भी
featureVerifiedDoctors.desc: सत्यापित स्वास्थ्य सेवा पेशेवरों से सुरक्षित वीडियो परामर्श के माध्यम से कहीं भी जुड़ें।

featureOnlineConsultations.title: एआई-संचालित क्लिनिकल सहायता
featureOnlineConsultations.desc: एआई और मशीन लर्निंग डॉक्टरों को परामर्श सारांश, क्लिनिकल दस्तावेज़ीकरण और बुद्धिमान प्रिस्क्रिप्शन ड्राफ्ट में सहायता करता है — प्रत्येक रोगी की स्थिति के अनुसार व्यक्तिगत आहार और पोषण मार्गदर्शन के साथ।

featureSmartScheduling.title: कभी फ़ॉलो-अप न भूलें
featureSmartScheduling.desc: स्वचालित रिमाइंडर रोगियों को अपनी देखभाल योजनाओं पर ट्रैक रखते हैं।

featureAiAssistedCare.title: आपका स्वास्थ्य, स्थायी रूप से दर्ज
featureAiAssistedCare.desc: सुरक्षित, एन्क्रिप्ट किए गए इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्वास्थ्य रिकॉर्ड रोगी के पूरे जीवन में निरंतर, सूचित देखभाल सुनिश्चित करते हैं।

featureDigitalPrescriptions.title: डिजाइन से गोपनीयता
featureDigitalPrescriptions.desc: हर रिकॉर्ड फील्ड-स्तरीय एन्क्रिप्शन से सुरक्षित है और DPDP अधिनियम 2023 सिद्धांतों के अनुसार निर्मित है, ताकि रोगी डेटा डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से निजी रहे, पश्चिमोत्तर विचार से नहीं।

featureHealthRecords.title: पहले रोकथाम
featureHealthRecords.desc: व्यक्तिगत पोषण, स्वास्थ्य और जीवनशैली मार्गदर्शन रोगियों को केवल बीमारी का इलाज नहीं करते समय स्वस्थ रहने में मदद करता है।

featureNearbyHospitals.title: स्मार्ट अस्पताल मार्गदर्शन
featureNearbyHospitals.desc: शारीरिक परीक्षण, प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण, या आपातकालीन देखभाल की आवश्यकता होने पर नजदीकी अस्पतालों के लिए बुद्धिमान, वास्तविक समय की सिफारिशें।

featureLabGuidance.title: बाधाओं के बिना देखभाल
featureLabGuidance.desc: बहुभाषी एआई-संचालित समर्थन, प्रत्येक रोगी के लिए सरल और सुलभ होने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया।

featureEmergencyGuidance.title: बाधाओं के बिना देखभाल
featureEmergencyGuidance.desc: बहुभाषी एआई-संचालित समर्थन, प्रत्येक रोगी के लिए सरल और सुलभ होने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया।

aiHeadline: AI That Assists — Doctors Still Decide
aiDesc: SehatSetu uses artificial intelligence to make healthcare workflows more efficient, such as organizing information, assisting with healthcare navigation, and supporting structured medical documentation.
aiDesc2: AI-generated information is designed to support—not replace—qualified healthcare professionals. Diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, and critical medical decisions remain under human medical supervision.
aiPoint1: Human-in-the-loop — AI supports structured workflows reviewed by qualified professionals.
aiPoint2: Safety-first emergency handling — high-risk situations always direct to urgent in-person care.
aiPoint3: Structured and reviewable AI output — responses are organized, traceable, and human-reviewable.
accessibilityDesc: SehatSetu is designed with both rural and urban healthcare access in mind. Digital consultations, nearby hospital discovery, lightweight healthcare workflows, and multilingual support can help reduce barriers caused by distance and digital complexity.
privacyDesc: Protecting your health information is fundamental to everything we do. SehatSetu applies secure authentication, controlled access to medical records, privacy-conscious AI integration, and secure handling of documents and communications.
privacyPoint2: Protected health information with controlled access
step1Desc: Share your health concern and preferred doctor or specialty.
step2Desc: Discover verified doctors, time slots, hospitals, and lab guidance.
step3Desc: Book a consultation, locate care nearby, or get structured guidance.
step4Desc: Access your appointments, prescriptions, and health records in one place.

valueAccessibility.title: Accessibility
valueAccessibility.desc: Healthcare should be easier to reach.

valueTrust.title: Trust
valueTrust.desc: Healthcare technology must prioritize reliability and transparency.

valueHumanCentred.title: Human-Centred Care
valueHumanCentred.desc: Technology should support the relationship between patients and healthcare professionals.

valueResponsibleInnovation.title: Responsible Innovation
valueResponsibleInnovation.desc: AI should improve workflows without replacing medical judgment.

finalCtaTitle: Better Access to Healthcare Starts Here
finalCtaDesc: Find the right doctor, manage your care, and access essential healthcare services through SehatSetu.
